items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: Miroslav and Mraz came to town shortly thereafter, as did Jan, we played together.

ctx.x: Well ever since then because that summer I ended up spending the whole summer in Europe. I’ll just mention this briefly, you might have known about it or maybe not but, and this was total coincidence but it also was instrumental in helping my career along. When the tour was over we noticed in DownBeat that it was an international jazz competition in Vienna. And it turns out it was the only time this was held, 1966. So several of us made our way from Athens. I think that’s where the tour dropped us off, to Vienna.…

Kuhn, James Williams, Franco Ambrosetti, Eddie Daniels, and I’m leaving out a lot of people that became famous in Europe. So this was really instrumental in all our development. We got to play together a lot and meet the judges, pal around, and when I moved to New York I didn’t quite finish but I went to NYU for a semester and then I kind of got enveloped into the work scene. It was a lot of work back then and I had met Thad and I mean Mel, and Mel asked me to join his big band, and Ron was calling me for gigs,…
It’s kind of like a fairy tale if you ask me.
